subject: Post-demo buying committee recap - FinTechCo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fintechco.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-08T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo buying committee recap - FinTechCo

Hi Alicia and Ben -

Thanks again for carving out time today to run the buying committee demo. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. I’ve attached a one-pager and a suggested evaluation plan for your team.

Key takeaways from today’s session:
- Decision criteria: performance (latency under 200ms p50), privacy (VPC or private deployment), cost per 1M tokens, and integration with existing SSO/KMS.
- Stakeholders we heard today: Alicia (Head of Product / economic buyer), Ben (Head of Security / security & compliance), Rachel (Procurement contact - purchasing/PO).
- Technical questions: SAML SSO, SOC2 evidence, data residency options, and quantization/throughput tradeoffs for short-form generation workloads.

Proposed next steps & owners:
1) Security packet and SOC2 summary - Marissa (I’ll send the SOC2 summary + SAML guide and our security one-pager by EOD tomorrow).
2) Technical deep-dive for Ben’s infra team - Connor O’Brien (solutions engineer) to schedule a 60-min session to walk the architecture and perf tuning.
3) Evaluation plan & success metrics - Jasmine Liu (customer success) will share a 4-week pilot plan and measurement template.
4) Procurement/contracting - Rachel, if you can share preferred PO terms and any required vendor forms we’ll queue the preliminary MSA + pricing range.

Attachments: redwood-post-demo-recap.pdf, fintechco-eval-plan.xlsx

If that aligns, I’ll coordinate the calendar invites and send the security artifacts.

Thanks -

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
https://redwood.com

From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-09T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee recap - FinTechCo

Thanks Marissa - good recap. A few items from security side:

- Can you confirm whether we can do a private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed KMS? We need to ensure keys never leave our control.
- What SOC 2 scope do you publish (Type II, which controls)? A one-page summary would be ideal.
- For our infra team: what are the typical GPU footprints and recommended replication for HA? Connor, can we get a perf/architecture doc ahead of the deep-dive?

Also, procurement (cc Rachel) will need a rough ARR/commitment pricing band to take to legal - even a ballpark helps with internal prioritization.

Ben Turner
Head of Security | FinTechCo
ben.turner@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fintechco.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Rachel Cole <rachel.procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-02-09T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee recap - FinTechCo

Appreciate the prompt questions Ben. Quick responses and owners below:

- Private deployment & KMS: yes - we support VPC/private deployment with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations. I’m attaching a short SAML/KMS integration guide and our SOC 2 summary (see attachment).
- SOC 2: Type II (security + availability scope) - I’ll include the one-page summary and the auditor contact in the packet.
- Perf/replication: Connor has prepared a short perf note and recommended GPU/replication configurations for the use case you showed - Connor, I’ll let you add that doc and propose times for the deep-dive.
- Pricing band: for an annual committed Dedicated plan with the throughput you described, the typical ARR range is $120k-60k depending on burst/replication and retention settings. We can provide a more precise quote after sizing.

Action items:
- Marissa: send SOC2 one-pager, SAML/KMS integration guide, and security FAQ (attachment: redwood-security-packet.pdf) - by 2027-02-10 EOD.
- Connor O'Brien: schedule technical deep-dive (60 min) and share perf note by 2027-02-11.
- Jasmine Liu: send 4-week pilot plan + acceptance criteria by 2027-02-11.
- Rachel: please share any vendor form and PO cadence so Legal/Finance can align.

DocuSign: I’ll prepare a preliminary MSA and pricing appendix and share via DocuSign for internal review if that helps accelerate procurement (link to follow).

Thanks all - I’ll follow up with calendar invites.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-security-packet.pdf

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@fintechco.com>, Rachel Cole <rachel.procurement@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee recap - FinTechCo

Thanks Marissa - that timeframe works. A couple of quick asks from our side before scheduling:

1) Can you send the SOC2 one-pager and the customer-managed KMS note so Ben can validate with infra?
2) For budgeting: the ARR band you provided is helpful - can you confirm if that includes a 30-day pilot (no charge) or if pilots are billed? We’d prefer a short pilot to validate integration and perf.
3) I’m the economic buyer here; I’ll need a short exec summary (1 page) that calls out ROI drivers (cost savings vs our current provider, latency improvements, and operational efficiency) to take to finance next week.

If you can get those items to us by EOD tomorrow, I’ll set the internal calendar for the technical deep-dive and loop finance/legal.

Appreciate it -

Alicia Gomez
Head of Product | FinTechCo
alicia.gomez@fintechco.com
